answer: {"instructions":"These are Kosovo-Albanian (Gheg dialect) social media comments on daily COVID-19 updates from the health institute (IKSHPK). Light jokes cheering progress also count as positive, as does a bare friend tag paired with a well-wish like 'urime' (congratulations).","neutral":"Bare name tags with nothing else; factual questions (which municipality, which neighbourhood); posted statistics; neutral observations or jokes about numbers ('ja nisi apet' = it started again); requests or suggestions for stricter measures or testing; a personal account plus a calm appeal to be careful; mild puzzlement ('pak e çuditshme' = a bit strange) without accusation.","negative":"Anger, insults, accusations or contempt: claiming the numbers are lies or faked, blaming or demanding resignation of the government/ministers (Zemaj, Hoti), insulting citizens who ignore rules, boredom/disgust with the reports, sarcasm.
